feeds.title: French Wedding Style
feeds.description: French Wedding Style is the award-winning home of French Weddings for those planning a destination wedding in France. It is dedicated to providing a premium resource to help brides plan their weddings in France and provide inspiration for French Weddings.

feeds.title: Wild Roses Blog
feeds.description: Documenting your memories with your loved ones. Making photo sessions effortless, to create tender and fun pictures. Wild Roses is the French Riviera based Family and Wedding Photographer.

feeds.title: French-bague-ette Blog
feeds.description: French-bague-ette is the wedding inspiration and wedding planning service. Follow this blog that focuses on wedding planning and styling in France.

feeds.title: Ceremonize Blog
feeds.description: In this blog, we share with you our tips and tricks, our real weddings to help you in your quest for inspiration. I'm Virginie Mention, founder of Ceremonize, certified wedding planner since 2009 and wedding celebrant. Me and my team is committed to offering you a unique and exclusive service for a seamless celebration.

feeds.title: Wild Roses Studio Blog
feeds.description: Are you looking for a photographer on the French Riviera? Look no further! With my years of experience and creativity, I can make sure your pictures look amazing. Planning a destination wedding in an unfamiliar location can present its own set of challenges. However, as a wedding photographer specializing in the French Riviera, I am here to assist you. I am more than willing to offer my expertise and guide you in selecting exceptional wedding vendors and venues for your special day.

feeds.title: Albe Editions
feeds.description: ALBE EDITIONS accompanies and inspires the bride and groom in the preparation of their big day. The aesthetics and the spirit of the magazine on digital, social networks and print, are appreciated by future spouses, who are looking for practical advice, inspiring ideas and addresses of service providers far from the conventional clichés of marriage.

feeds.title: Capyture Blog
feeds.description: From the Alsatian plains, to the Swiss mountains, via the Moroccan desert or the Irish hills, discover the images of our wedding reports and our engagement sessions on our blog. We are Robby & Marina and we are wedding photographers. We like design, art, architecture, simple and authentic things, traveling, beautiful encounters and beautiful stories, sharing good times, emotions & light.

feeds.title: Katerina Meyvial Blog
feeds.description: Katerina is a wedding planner based in Paris. She helps couples organize their destination wedding, elopement, or wedding weekend in France. In this blog, she is sharing with you her knowledge and give you access to (almost) all her favorite wedding venues in Paris and its surrounding!

feeds.title: Pétillante Weddings Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nicole! I bring more than 10 years of experience to my wedding planning business and love to share free advice in the form of this blog. Nicole started Pétillante Weddings to help English-speaking couples. She saw the difficulties they faced, not only with planning a French destination wedding from around the world, but also because of confusion around French wedding industry norms.

feeds.title: Elodie Villemus Weddings Blog
feeds.description: Take a look at our wedding news and find wedding ideas for your wedding organization, wedding decoration, wedding venue and wedding dress. Elodie Villemus Weddings is one of the most influential Destination Wedding Planner & Wedding Designer agencies in France and Europe. This is the place where bespoke wedding planning and design meets French savoir-faire.

feeds.title: J'ai 2 Amours Blog
feeds.description: Native of this beautiful region that is Provence, a place that I particularly like, I would be able to make you discover exceptional places for your reception, with my incredible team. Explore the blog for more tips and advice for wedding planning.

feeds.title: Love My Dress » France
feeds.description: Explore wedding content highlights, exclusive news, offers and insights. Love My Dress is a soulful platform for weddings, founded by Annabel Beeforth. We encourage heartfelt wedding celebrations through honest storytelling and thoughtful, uplifting, relatable content.

feeds.title: Chateau Bee Blog
feeds.description: French wedding blog by Chateau Bee is everything you need to know about getting married in France and the best venues from Brittany to Provence. Here at the Chateau Bee Selection we showcase only the very best wedding venues in France. We have personally visited hundreds of wedding venues all across France and only choose the 'crème de la crème' for our Selection. This way all you have to worry about is which place you love most!

feeds.title: L'Atelier 5 Blog
feeds.description: Discover the latest news from our 10 tailor-made clothing stores L'Atelier 5. Atelier 5 is above all personalities! Each & everyone has established L'Atelier 5 in their city with their know-how in the world of made-to-measure.
